A theme sets the colours of Switchboard: the app, the code blocks and diffs, and the terminal, for light and dark mode. Switchboard comes with thirteen themes, and you can [import your own](/themes/custom/).

<Screenshot name="settings-theme" alt="Settings open on Theme: the Appearance control, then a grid of theme cards, each with a light and a dark preview, its name and author, and a dashed card to drop a theme file on" eager />

## Open it

- Press <Kbd shortcut="settings" /> (or click the gear at the bottom of the sidebar) and choose **Theme**.
- In the command palette (<Kbd shortcut="palette.commands" />), run *Theme: &lt;name&gt;* to switch to a theme, or *Appearance: Match System*, *Appearance: Light* or *Appearance: Dark* to change the mode. The palette only lists the choices you aren't using now.

## Choose light or dark

**Appearance** at the top of Settings → Theme has three choices:

- **Match System** (the default): follows <Os mac="macOS" windows="Windows" />, so Switchboard turns dark when your system does.
- **Light**
- **Dark**

The terminal panel is always dark, in light mode too.

## Pick a theme

Click a theme card to use it. It applies at once, and a message in the corner says "Switched to &lt;name&gt;" with **Undo**, which takes you back to the theme you had.

Each card shows the theme in light and dark mode, its name, and who made it, with *built in* or *imported*. The theme in use has a ring in its own accent colour and a check mark.

| Theme | Light mode | Dark mode |
|---|---|---|
| Demo Time (the default) | Demo Time Light | Demo Time Dark |
| Catppuccin | Latte | Mocha |
| Nord | uses Demo Time | Nord |
| Solarized | Solarized Light | Solarized Dark |

<Aside title="Dark only">
Nord has only a dark version, as the original does. Its card says **Dark only**. In light mode it shows Demo Time, and Settings says so under the cards: with Match System, light mode uses Demo Time.
</Aside>

### Themes that match the app icons

Nine themes match the colourways of the [app icon](/settings/#app-icon), each in light and dark: **Graphite**, **Midnight**, **Paper**, **Signal**, **Forest**, **Plum**, **Aluminium**, **Ocean** and **Neon**. Pick the icon and its theme together, or mix them as you like.

If you used the Claude or The unnamed theme, which are no longer built in, Switchboard switches to Demo Time.

<Screenshot name="theme-catppuccin" alt="The main window in the Catppuccin theme: the sidebar, a conversation and the Changes panel in Catppuccin's colours" />

## More for a theme

Each card has a **⋯** button (or right-click the card, or press <Kbd shortcut="context-menu" first />):

- **Export…** saves the theme as a `.json` file. Exporting Demo Time gives you every colour, a good start for a theme of your own.
- **Duplicate** adds an editable copy to your themes.
- **Show file** and **Remove** are only there for themes you imported. Built-in themes can't be removed.

See [Custom themes](/themes/custom/) for importing, exporting and editing theme files.

## Settings

Everything on this page is in [Settings → Theme](/settings/#theme). Your theme and appearance are part of the preferences you can [back up](/settings/backup/).
